purpose: Non-secret deployment preflight for the AirlineDemo Sweden Central demonstrator.

authorization.note: This record captures approved inputs and a readiness gate. It does not authorize provisioning or spending.

subscription.note: The subscription identifier is privately held and must be supplied at deployment time; it is not committed here.

tenant.note: The tenant identifier is privately held and must be supplied at deployment time; it is not committed here.

checks.requirement: Explicitly confirm that Azure Container Apps consumption hosting, the Azure Container Registry SKU, Azure SQL, evidence storage, monitoring, and Azure OpenAI configuration are available in Sweden Central.
Explicitly confirm the exact Azure OpenAI model name and version selected for Sweden Central before Terraform apply, then pin that selection for the deployment.
Explicitly confirm that the Azure OpenAI deployment type is Standard.
Explicitly confirm approximately 30K TPM quota for the selected model deployment.

readinessGate.substitutionPolicy: The swedencentral region and the exact model/version confirmed by this gate must not be silently substituted. A failed check requires an explicit changed decision.
readinessGate.authorization: Passing this gate authorizes neither provisioning nor spending.
